definitions.rows: maths: E40's maths_rows.json rows 0-127 cut to their first 256 tokens (as E44 Amendment 2); own: E45 Job.own_rows (64 packed rows of 512) cut to 256; the plain, prompted, think (T), length-matched (L) rows are per-problem rows of GSM8K test 0-127 (section 4 row 3); C reads E44's 128 FineWeb rows of 512 (experiments/qwen_adversary/results/tokens.json)
definitions.cells: per-row sums of KL per position, fp32, Delta off. K00: KL(FT || CI-masked, original subcomponents, g0); K01: original, g1; K10: least-squares split, g0 (V' in the readouts, W0's activations); K11: split, g1; K0: KL(W0 || CI-masked at W0, original). g0 = Gamma on W0's forward, g1 = Gamma on FT's forward
definitions.regating_share: (K00 - K01) / (K00 - K11) from the summed rows; direct share (K00 - K10) / (K00 - K11); unscored when K11 - K0 > 0.5 (K00 - K0) or K00 - K0 <= 0 (as E45), or when K00 - K11 < floor
definitions.floor: max(0.05, 5 x 0.000208) = 0.05 nats (E45's filed floor; 0.000208 is E44 C.json's stochastic spread), on the share's denominator
definitions.bootstrap: 2000 resamples of the rows (random.Random(0)), the share from the resampled sums; 95% interval = the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the finite resamples
definitions.gated_on: a live subcomponent with g > 0.01 at >= 1% of the positions read (E45's filed definition); live = the E44 alive set (494598)
definitions.switched_on: S(state) = gated on under g1 and not under g0, on the maths rows; a reference set X = gated on in its context and not in the plain no-think rows, on answer positions (the tokens after the row's last </think>; FineWeb rows: every position)
definitions.split_half_floor: the larger of |on(rows 64-127) and not on(rows 0-63)| and the reverse, W0, maths rows; a set is scored only if |set| >= max(20, 5 x that count)
definitions.overlap: o_X = |S and X|; draws: 1000 site-stratified random sets (each site the count S has there, drawn from its live subcomponents; numpy default_rng(0) hypergeometric per site); e_X = (o_X - mean) / sd of the draws (sd: population); q(p) = the ceil(p x 1000)-th smallest draw; 'above the 99th percentile' = o_X > q(0.99); 'at or below the 95th' = o_X <= q(0.95)

prompt_overlap.measurement: o_P, the overlap of the state's S with S_prompt (row 2's positive control: W0 with E45's format system prompt, same answer tokens), against the draws
prompt_overlap.unscored: |S_prompt| below the split-half floor (every state), |S| below it (that state), or a draw sd of 0

think_overlap.measurement: o_T, the overlap of S with T (W0's think-on answers), against the draws
think_overlap.anchor2: o_T <= q(0.95) on each seed ('at chance')
think_overlap.unscored: |T|, |L| or |C| < 20 (every state), |S| below the split-half floor (that state), or a draw sd of 0

validated.rule: for prompt_overlap and think_overlap separately, on e_X: both anchors scored on both seeds, and |mean(anchor 1) - mean(anchor 2)| strictly exceeds both the larger within-anchor seed gap and 2 x the gap's row-bootstrap s.e.
validated.direction: anchor 1 above anchor 2 for both rows; a validated gap in the other direction is announced as a reversal
validated.unscored_seed: an anchor seed unscored: the row is not validated (a single-seed observation)

rules.domain_confound: every anchor reading carries: anchor 1 shares its domain (GSM8K maths), anchor 2 does not (invented facts)

edge_cases: the think row unscored for every state; reported
draw sd of 0 (S fills every live slot of its sites, or X is empty or full there)
a think row whose trace does not close </think> in 2048 tokens
dropped from T (and its L row); > 25% dropped stops Stage B

amendment_2026-10-30.status_note: amended 2026-10-30 before any run, per code review (a fresh agent's review of commit be6f5bd); nothing had run. Where an item below and the text above differ, the item below holds
amendment_2026-10-30.floor: the share's floor (0.05) is on the denominator in mean nats per position, (K00 - K11) / positions read; the code had compared it with per-row KL sums (commute.qwen_reading.shares takes the position count)
amendment_2026-10-30.overlap_pool: the draws come, per site, from the pool of live subcomponents NOT gated on under g0 on the maths rows (W0, Stage A's counts), the only place a switched-on set S can lie; N and K are counted inside the pool, o = |S and X| as before. The code had drawn from every live subcomponent (about 17% of live are on at W0 on the maths rows), which reads the null low and e about +2 sd high; the seed-pair control was inflated the same way
amendment_2026-10-30.null_seeds: each Gaussian null (split.random_like: the C0 off-span control, row 4's nulls, the placement nulls) is seeded per site, seed x 1000 + the site's index in SITES, so sites of one shape no longer share one Gaussian matrix. Departure from E44's stage S, which used seed 0 at every site
amendment_2026-10-30.think_overlap_validation: think_overlap is scored on anchor 2 alone, on both seeds (each 'holds' or 'misses'); the validated-gap rule applies to prompt_overlap only. Anchor 1's e_T is reported, unfiled, with no status

early_added.C_g0: every C0 and C state's g0 gate counts on the maths rows equal Stage A's W0 counts exactly. Miss: stop

amendment_2026-10-30.W0_control: the W0 control's fine-tuned weight set is a separate pinned copy of W0, so it goes through the same copy path as every update
